title: Signed total Cech homology pairing with axis formulas
statement: Let X be a scheme and U any family of its opens, and let F,G be module sheaves. Let D be a computing resolution pairing of F,G [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data]. For each of its left, right and target complexes let alpha be a chain map from its global sections complex to the total of its Cech double complex [def-sc-cech-cup-resolution-comparison-data], with components equal to moduleCechZero followed by inclusion of bidegree (n,0). Let beta be a chain map from the coefficient Cech complex to the same total, with components given by the resolution augmentation in degree zero followed by inclusion of bidegree (0,n). No invertibility or identification with sheaf cohomology is assumed for these maps. For every p,q there exists a Gamma(X,top)-bilinear pairing on the total homologies in degrees p,q into degree p+q. It takes the alpha classes of global resolution cycles a,b to the alpha class of any resolution cycle c with c.val = D.pair p q top a.val b.val. It takes the beta classes of coefficient Cech cycles a,b to the beta class of any Cech cycle c with c.val = cechCupCochain U F G p q a.val b.val [def-sc-cech-cup-product].

proof.text: Obtain the signed total tensor cochain morphism h and its alpha and beta cochain equations from exists_cupCech_total_cochain_pairing. This applies to arbitrary indexed opens and arbitrary computing resolution pairing, with no quasi-isomorphism condition on axis maps.

Define tensorInsert by the bilinear pure-tensor map followed by the tensor-total summand inclusion. Expand the two total differential terms using Mathlib mapBifunctor.d_eq, iota_D1, iota_D2, d1_eq and d2_eq. This gives the signed Leibniz identity. Postcompose with h and use its cochain identity. Restrict to the cycle kernels. In degree zero the incoming differential vanishes; in a positive left degree, a boundary times a cycle is the differential of the tensor pairing of its primitive with that cycle. For a positive right degree use the primitive pairing multiplied by (-1)^p. In both cases explicit degree transports identify the primitive differential with the desired boundary. Apply the proved private bilinear_homology_desc helper in this module, reproduced from CechCupProduct without importing its private environment, based on LinearMap.liftQ2 and moduleCatHomologyIso, to descend the same cycle pairing through both boundary submodules.

The supplied six component equations give equality of each chain map with cupCechAlpha or cupCechBeta by HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext. Define their maps on concrete cycle kernels through moduleCatCyclesIso and cyclesMap. Prove underlying-cochain naturality using cyclesMap_i, and cycle-class naturality using homologyPi_naturality. On either axis use the corresponding cochain equation of h. The assumed equation for c.val identifies its image with the paired cycle by Subtype.ext. The descended pairing formula then gives both requested homology equations. The coefficient cochain formula n2CechCupCochain of the existing h theorem is definitionally equal to cechCupCochain. Use the lightweight CechCupProductCore formula directly to avoid importing the derived cup invariance proof; it is definitionally the same coefficient cochain.

theorem cupCech_signed_axis_pairing {X : Scheme.{v}} {ι : Type v}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) {F G : X.Modules} (D : CupResolutionPairing F G)
    (lalpha : ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.left.K ⟶
      (cupCechDouble U D.left.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (lbeta : (cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat ⟶
      (cupCechDouble U D.left.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (hlalpha : ∀ n : ℕ, lalpha.f n = moduleCechZero U (D.left.K.X n) ≫
      (cupCechDouble U D.left.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n 0 n (by simp))
    (hlbeta : ∀ n : ℕ, lbeta.f n =
      ((cechComplexFunctor U).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
          (D.left.augmentation.f 0).val)).f n ≫
        (cupCechDouble U D.left.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 n n (by simp))
    (ralpha : ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.right.K ⟶
      (cupCechDouble U D.right.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (rbeta : (cechComplexFunctor U).obj G.presheafModuleCat ⟶
      (cupCechDouble U D.right.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (hralpha : ∀ n : ℕ, ralpha.f n = moduleCechZero U (D.right.K.X n) ≫
      (cupCechDouble U D.right.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n 0 n (by simp))
    (hrbeta : ∀ n : ℕ, rbeta.f n =
      ((cechComplexFunctor U).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
          (D.right.augmentation.f 0).val)).f n ≫
        (cupCechDouble U D.right.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 n n (by simp))
    (talpha : ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.target.K ⟶
      (cupCechDouble U D.target.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (tbeta : (cechComplexFunctor U).obj (F ⊗ G).presheafModuleCat ⟶
      (cupCechDouble U D.target.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (htalpha : ∀ n : ℕ, talpha.f n = moduleCechZero U (D.target.K.X n) ≫
      (cupCechDouble U D.target.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n 0 n (by simp))
    (htbeta : ∀ n : ℕ, tbeta.f n =
      ((cechComplexFunctor U).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
          (D.target.augmentation.f 0).val)).f n ≫
        (cupCechDouble U D.target.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 n n (by simp))
    (p q : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : ((cupCechDouble U D.left.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology p →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
      ((cupCechDouble U D.right.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology q →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
        ((cupCechDouble U D.target.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology (p + q),
      (∀ (a : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.left.K).sc p).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
        (b : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.right.K).sc q).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
        (c : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.target.K).sc (p + q)).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K),
        c.val = D.pair p q ⊤ a.val b.val →
          t (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap lalpha p (cupCycleClass _ p a))
              (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ralpha q (cupCycleClass _ q b)) =
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap talpha (p + q) (cupCycleClass _ (p + q) c)) ∧
      (∀ (a : (((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat).sc
          p).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
        (b : (((cechComplexFunctor U).obj G.presheafModuleCat).sc
          q).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
        (c : (((cechComplexFunctor U).obj (F ⊗ G).presheafModuleCat).sc
          (p + q)).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K),
        c.val = n2CechCupCochain U F G p q a.val b.val →
          t (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap lbeta p (cupCycleClass _ p a))
              (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap rbeta q (cupCycleClass _ q b)) =
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap tbeta (p + q) (cupCycleClass _ (p + q) c))
